verses.da-a-l-biladu-c1-v1: ḍāʾa l-bilādu waṣāḥa l-qawmu min ʾufuqi biʿawdi ʾaḥmadinā l-maktūmi min ʾumami
verses.da-a-l-biladu-c1-v2: lammā raʾaynā t-tijānī min sayyāratihi surra l-qulūbu washadda ṭ-ṭarbu lil-karami
verses.da-a-l-biladu-c1-v3: faṭābati ṭ-ṭaqsu wal-ʾashjāru nāḍirata waʾabrada l-jawwu takrīmā ʿalā l-qadimi
verses.da-a-l-biladu-c1-v4: faqabbala l-ʾahlu wal-ʾaḥbābu min faraḥi istabshara l-kullu yā bushrā lil-ylihimi
verses.da-a-l-biladu-c1-v5: ʾinna l-qudūma lihadhā sh-shaykhi makrumahu yā llāhu zidnā dawāmā quwwata l-ʿiṣami
verses.da-a-l-biladu-c1-v6: bijāhi man fayḍuhu ʿamma l-bilāda maʿā yā rabbi ʾasbil ʿalaynā wābila s-salami
